note: Somerset County PA does not publish a countywide zoning layer: the county Planning Commission administers only the 1970 Interchange Area ordinance and the Rt. 31 West Corridor ordinance, as PDFs. Somerset Borough's zoning map is kept for inspection at borough offices, and no city or borough zoning layer was found on the county hub, ArcGIS Online or the county server (gis.co.somerset.pa.us did not respond). Zoning is published only as PDF documents.
